title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: A young girl in the segregated American South learns about justice, racism and compassion as her father defends a wrongly accused Black man in court.

author: George Orwell
description: In a totalitarian superstate ruled by constant surveillance and propaganda, a low-ranking party worker begins to question the regime that controls every aspect of life.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A mysterious millionaire's obsessive pursuit of a lost love exposes the glamour and moral decay of Jazz Age America.

title: Of Mice and Men
author: John Steinbeck
description: Two displaced migrant ranch workers, bound by friendship and a shared dream of owning their own farm, struggle to survive during the Great Depression.

title: Brave New World
author: Aldous Huxley
description: In a genetically engineered future built on comfort and conformity, one man begins to question the cost of a world without pain, conflict or freedom.

title: Fahrenheit 451
author: Ray Bradbury
description: In a future where books are outlawed and burned by firemen, one fireman begins to question his role after meeting a woman who dares to think for herself.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
author: J.D. Salinger
description: A disillusioned teenager wanders New York City over a few days, grappling with alienation, loss and the phoniness of the adult world.

title: Lord of the Flies
author: William Golding
description: A group of boys stranded on a deserted island descend into savagery as they attempt to govern themselves without adult supervision.

title: Animal Farm
author: George Orwell
description: Farm animals overthrow their human owner in hopes of equality, only to see the revolution corrupted by a new ruling class among their own.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: A reluctant hobbit is swept into an epic quest to reclaim a dwarven kingdom from a fearsome dragon.

title: The Lord of the Rings
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: A fellowship of unlikely heroes sets out to destroy a powerful ring before it falls into the hands of a dark lord.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerers Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
description: An orphaned boy discovers he is a wizard and begins his first year at a magical school, uncovering secrets about his past along the way.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
author: J.K. Rowling
description: A mysterious force begins petrifying students at a school of magic, and a young wizard must uncover the truth behind a legendary hidden chamber.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A young shepherd travels from Spain to Egypt in search of treasure, discovering along the way that the real journey is about following one's own dreams.

title: Don Quixote
author: Miguel de Cervantes
description: An aging nobleman, driven mad by chivalric romances, sets out as a knight-errant with his loyal squire to right the wrongs of the world.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez
description: The multigenerational saga of the Buendia family traces the rise and fall of the mythical town of Macondo.

title: The Old Man and the Sea
author: Ernest Hemingway
description: An aging Cuban fisherman engages in an epic battle with a giant marlin far out in the Gulf Stream.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
description: A destitute former student commits a murder to test his own theories of morality, then struggles with guilt and the possibility of redemption.

title: War and Peace
author: Leo Tolstoy
description: The sweeping story follows several aristocratic Russian families as their lives intertwine against the backdrop of the Napoleonic Wars.

title: The Divine Comedy
author: Dante Alighieri
description: A poet's allegorical journey through Hell, Purgatory and Paradise explores sin, redemption and the nature of divine justice.
